Messages.Author: Markus Schlein
Messages.Body:
Hi everyone,

please confirm:

Reaction cards can only be played by a ready, untaped minion.

(D) actions can only be blocked by one of her ready untapped minions.

Undirected actions can only be blocked by ready untapped minions of prey
and predator.

This means that I can not block my grandprey usinga tapped Vampire with
a 2nd tradition and an Eagle's Sight. ES can not be played, since the
minion is not untaped. 2nd can not be played before, since there is no
legal target for the block. Correct?

Regards,

-Markus

Messages.Author: Reyda
Messages.Body:
"Markus Schlein" <Markus....@gmx.de> wrote in message
news:3C50F89C...@gmx.de...

> Hi everyone,
>
> please confirm:
>
> Reaction cards can only be played by a ready, untaped minion.

YES, barring specific card text (falcon's eye, Wake with evening's
freshness, Reform body...)

> (D) actions can only be blocked by one of her ready untapped minions.

YES, by one of the targeted meth's minion. Tapped vampires can still block
using certains circonstances (2nd Trad, Wake with evening's freshness...)
Some other methusela can interfere by using specific cards (Eagle sight,
Anneke, Falcon's eye...)
But you already know that, don't you ;)

> Undirected actions can only be blocked by ready untapped minions of prey
> and predator.

YES again...

> This means that I can not block my grandprey usinga tapped Vampire with
> a 2nd tradition and an Eagle's Sight. ES can not be played, since the
> minion is not untaped. 2nd can not be played before, since there is no
> legal target for the block. Correct?

you are CORRECT on all points.
find a way to untap the vampire (or let him play reaction cards as if
untapped) prior to playing eagle sight.
Example : play Forced Awakening, then Eagle sight, then 2nd Tradition. It's2
card and is a bit complicated but it's the method you'll want to use to be
able to block passing all those restrictions.

reyda

> Regards,
>
> -Markus
